tracks.title: today is my favorite
tracks.excerpt: An album-length EP by the 20-year-old producer is a dizzying and boundless collage of collages, using free-jazz logic and digital overload to chart new emotional terrain.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位20岁的制片人制作了一张专辑长度的EP ，这是一张令人眼花缭乱的无限拼贴画，使用自由爵士逻辑和数字过载来绘制新的情感地形。

tracks.title: This is How it Should Be Done
tracks.excerpt: For their collaborative full-length debut, Eris Drew and Octo Octa hunkered down in their New Hampshire cabin to craft a celebratory, sample-heavy tribute to the maximalist dance music of yore.
tracks.excerpt_zh: Eris Drew和Octo Octa在他们的新罕布什尔州小木屋里蹲下，为他们合作的全长首演制作了一个庆祝性的样品，向昔日的极致舞曲致敬。

tracks.title: School's Out!
tracks.excerpt: The irreverent duo of Leo Fincham and Rowan Please plies its brilliantly digitized indie-pop bricolage on an album with the ragtag splendor of a low-budget musical.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 不敬的Leo Fincham和Rowan Please二人组合将其精彩的数字化独立流行拼凑在一张专辑中，并伴随着低成本音乐剧的破烂辉煌。

tracks.title: Concrete Beach
tracks.excerpt: A long neglected album dates to the beginning of Steve Gunn’s career, when it seemed that the guitarist might become a Takoma-style picker rather than the songwriter/improvisational experimenter he has since turned out to be. The playing is agile and folk-blues focused; the singing, when it comes, is similarly traditional and not as polished as Gunn has become. The music earned the approval of no
tracks.excerpt_zh: 一张长期被忽视的专辑可以追溯到史蒂夫·冈恩（ Steve Gunn ）的职业生涯的开始，当时吉他手似乎可能成为塔科马风格的选择者，而不是他后来成为的词曲作者/即兴实验者。演奏敏捷，以民间蓝调为重点；唱歌，当它到来时，同样是传统的，不像Gunn那样抛光。音乐获得了no的批准

tracks.title: The thing
tracks.excerpt: The Danish artist achieves a beguiling flow state on her second solo album: a set of future standards full of empty space.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位丹麦艺术家在她的第二张个人专辑中实现了一种迷人的流动状态：一套充满空旷空间的未来标准。

tracks.title: A MAN A CURE
tracks.excerpt: Cork trio Ana Palindrome make a hypnotic blend of art-pop, droning vocals, sawing fiddle, and glitchy folktronica on “A MAN A CURE,” their first release for London’s World of Echo. Beneath its pulsing rhythms and woozy electronics, the track questions the idea of self-made identity, as Niamh Dalton’s voice shifts between the organic and the artificial. The post Ana Palindrome :: A MAN A CURE first
tracks.excerpt_zh: 软木三人组Ana Palindrome在“A MAN A CURE”上融合了流行艺术、嗡嗡声、锯子小提琴和毛骨悚然的民谣，这是他们在伦敦回声世界的首次发行。随着Niamh Dalton的声音在有机音乐和人工音乐之间转换，在它的脉动节奏和昏昏欲睡的电子音乐下，赛道对自制身份的概念提出了质疑。文章Ana Palindrome:: A MAN A CURE first

tracks.title: Chords
tracks.netease_artist: Jason Dungan, Johan Carøe, Blue Lake
tracks.excerpt: Copenhagen-based composers Jason Dungan (Blue Lake) and Johan Carøe join forces on Routine , a quietly transportive collection of ambient folk and new age soundscapes shaped through an exchange of musical fragments. Blending acoustic instrumentation, electronics, and Dungan’s self-designed 36-string zither, the duo arrive at something intimate and unhurried—a luminous meditation on domestic ritual
tracks.excerpt_zh: 哥本哈根作曲家杰森·邓根（ Jason Dungan ） （蓝湖）和约翰·卡罗（ Johan Carøe ）联合创作了《例行公事》（ Routine ） ，这是一本通过音乐片段交换而形成的静悄悄地运输环境民谣和新时代音景的集合。两人融合了声学仪器、电子设备和Dungan自行设计的36弦琴弦，得到了一些亲密而又不着急的东西--对家庭仪式的发光冥想

tracks.title: I Had to Say This
tracks.excerpt: It can be difficult to verbalize exactly what autumnal records are capable of eliciting. One thing is undeniable: October and November are the months for The Clientele's 2000 debut album Suburban Light . tracks.excerpt: The UK selector throws caution—and genre—to the winds on an audacious 82-minute set that careens between ambient, drill’n’bass, post-punk, breakcore, and more.
